featured_reviews.name: Otsusuki
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disgraceful Zeno Health outlet. This place is a complete failure as a pharmacy. They don’t stock even the most basic generic medicines. If you need multiple medicines, expect them to have maybe one and give excuses for the rest. In situations where medicines are urgently needed, this level of incompetence is unacceptable.

Their ordering system is a joke. There is no transparency, no accountability, and no guarantee of when medicines will arrive. Even worse, medicines ordered by a patient are not reserved.

My father placed an order after being told the medicines were unavailable. He later received a call confirming the medicines had arrived. When he went to collect them, the staff bluntly admitted they had already sold them to someone else. This is beyond unprofessional—it’s unethical.

Selling medicines meant for one patient to another without consent or even informing the original customer shows complete disregard for patient welfare. This is not just bad service; it’s dangerous negligence, especially when dealing with essential medication.

This outlet is poorly managed, irresponsible, and unfit to function as a medical store. Patients should think twice before trusting this place with their health.
